hash_binding_semantics.meaning: Execution provenance continues to name the immutable local originals. Use each file original_sha256/public_sha256 mapping for publication derivatives; historical hashes are not assertions about redacted public bytes.
original_execution_provenance: source_sha256 and race_inputs recorded at execution
rebound: public source snapshot bindings for editorially cleaned specifications and report templates
public confirmation selected-record digest, freeze seal and run manifest
analysis provenance bound to the matching public fixture or sealed hosted inputs
hash_binding_semantics.runtime_scope: Simulation, policy, scoring, and replay code are byte-identical. Two M1 report templates contain editorial changes only.

limitations: No checkpoint inference or full retraining is reproduced.
Hosted model weights and measured latency are not reproduced.
Same-machine replay does not establish independent-machine reproduction.

privacy_review.scope: Selected export inputs only; omitted local files and existing public history are not rewritten.

result.scope: stored receipts and simulator outcomes verified; hosted weights not reproduced
stored receipts and simulator outcomes verified; hosted weights not reproduced
stored receipts, recorded policy advice and simulator outcomes verified; weights and measured latency are not reproduced
stored receipts, recorded policy advice and simulator outcomes verified; weights and measured latency are not reproduced

scientific_outcomes.interpretation: Replay integrity only; failed and skipped scientific outcomes remain failed or skipped.

verification.scope: Artifact integrity and exact recorded-evidence replay.
